tieu_de: AI Product Owner PATI OS, Product Management, Linux
dia_chi_raw: Midtown M7 Signature, Street 15, Tan My Ward
mo_ta_cong_viec:
PATI Group is not looking for a passive coder who waits for tickets. We are looking for a Product Manager — the product owner, for several product positions under PATI OS: AdLauncher, StoreLauncher, Creative Portal, AdVault, AI Portal, and Profit Center.
You turn department pain points into shipped internal products, hand them to non-technical users, and keep upgrading them against P&L. You will not ship every surface on day one — sequence with 80/20.
40% — Multi-app product ownership (PATI OS)
Outcome: each assigned product has a clear problem, roadmap, Definition of Done, and live users who can run it without you.
Concrete work:
Own briefs and roadmaps across AdLauncher, StoreLauncher, Creative Portal, AdVault, AI Portal, and Profit Center as capacity earns them.
Sit inside Marketing / Creative / Store / Ops / Finance workflows. Dig the real bottleneck — do not wait for a perfect ticket.
Sequence build vs buy vs kill. Cut features that do not move revenue, creative throughput, or cost.
Write requirements engineers and AI builders can execute: user, job-to-be-done, acceptance tests, failure modes.
Ship in thin slices. Demo to real users. Measure adoption. Run v2 from feedback — “1% better every day.”
25% — AI workflow & system design
Outcome: flows are repeatable and adoptable by non-technical staff (handover is part of Done).
Concrete work:
Design prompts, system instructions, agent roles, MCP/CLI hooks, and context/memory, so models execute reliably across PATI OS surfaces.
Prefer typed judgments and agent loops where they beat chat-and-paste.
Instrument products: usage, failure rates, time saved, quality gates before output hits ads, creators, or digests.
Partner with CTO / builders of architecture; You own the product outcome, not only the backlog list.
20% — Discovery, prioritization & P&L alignment
Outcome: every building ties to revenue, creative capacity, or measurable cost — not lab demos.
Concrete work:
Prioritize with managers and the board using 80/20 across the PATI OS portfolio.
Translate technical options into business language for leaders; argue toward clear requirements.
Track product metrics that matter: adoption, cycle time, rework, paid-tool replacement, quality escapes.
Kill or park work that does not clear the bar. Say no with evidence.
15% — Rollout, training & continuous upgrade
Outcome: products stay alive in production after launch.
Concrete work:
Train internal users; write short playbooks; own onboarding for each release.
Collect feedback, triage bugs vs enhancements, publish a visible changelog.
Keep AdLauncher, StoreLauncher, Creative Portal, AdVault, AI Portal, and Profit Center coherent under one product standard.
yeu_cau:
1–3 years in Product Management or Business Analysis, with a proven track record shipping digital products you personally build end-to-end (prefer multi-surface ownership).
Hands-on deploying AI / automation that non-technical teammates actually use (not only personal ChatGPT habits).
System mindset: can map a messy multi-team workflow, design an AI project structure, and manage context/memory so models execute.
Extreme ownership in ambiguity: start without a perfect spec; experiment; absorb failure and iterate.
Blunt, well-structured communication with department leaders — technical logic into plain business language.
Comfortable daily on macOS or Linux.
Everyday conversational English for product and engineering alignment.
Mindset & attitude that fit PATI
Builder’s 5 Mindsets: Ownership, Problem Solving, 100% Definition of Done, AI First, 80/20.
Thinking skills: first-principles, second-order, systems thinking.
Working attitude:
Integrity: finish completely; surface risk early with a plan — do not hide until it becomes an incident.
Want to own products in production, not slide decks.
Like a fast, challenging environment and own your decisions.
Believe continuous self-learning is the basis for growth.
quyen_loi:
Compensation:
Rank A1–A4: 7.5–14.5 million VND / month (by capability and results — PATI does not “cào bằng”).
Probation: 2 months at 85% pay. Compensation review on results (company cadence applies).
13th-month pay; holiday/Tet bonus; birthday; company trip.
Full social, health, and unemployment insurance; Bao Viet health insurance.
Frontier AI (uncapped for work):
Company-funded frontier access, including Claude Code 20x, ChatGPT 20x, SuperGrok Heavy, KIMI Vivace (20x), Google Ultra, and Seedance.
PATI is Agent-first: you are expected to use the best models in the world as operating infrastructure, not as a side tool.
Career path:
Work directly with CoS / CTO / CMO lanes on product priority; propose what to build next with evidence.
Path: Product Manager → Senior PM / Product Lead on real shipped portfolio impact, not tenure
Working hours
Mon–Fri: 8:30–17:30. Sat: 8:00–12:30. On-site.
Location: Midtown M7 Signature, Street 15, Tan My Ward, HCMC.
Bring your personal laptop. Company MacBook and senior benefits at Senior level.
